description.en: Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
description.zh: DSH 原生 Windows 桌面窗口（WebView2）：一条命令安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 拉取应用包，创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在会话内启动。
